outcome: Duration of third stage of labor
Maternal physical and psychological status at 42 days postpartum
cohort: 352 high-risk pregnant women exposed to obstetric complications with an Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale score ≥ 9 or a Postpartum Depression Screening Scale score ≥ 60
finding: A prenatal psychological intervention program for high-risk pregnant women resulted in a significantly lower cesarean rate, shorter third stage of labor, and improved maternal physical and psychological status at 42 days postpartum.
mod_finding: The intervention group had a significantly lower cesarean rate.
